theme: choosing which shepherds anchor a drifting flock
title: Shepherds of the Drifting Flock
strategies: degree/centrality top-k: pin the highest-degree nodes -- wastes budget inside dense hubs/cliques, blind to far pendant structure

sequential marginal-gain (additive-gain) greedy: recompute lambda_min for every candidate addition, always take the single best next node -- the classical leader-selection recipe, provably stuck by non-submodularity on the planted twin-hub / dumbbell / chain instances

resistance-farthest-cover construction + local pairwise-swap refinement: initialize by repeatedly adding the node farthest, in effective-resistance distance, from the current anchor set (covers every pendant branch), then jointly refine via swaps that recompute the true lambda_min -- a qualitatively different, coordinated search over the covering structure
open: multi-restart / simulated-annealing joint search over anchor sets in resistance space, or exact combinatorial search on small instances
